---
title: "04 - Check the 3D MGtoolbox signal distribution"
author: "Xinyi Chen"
output: html_document
---

This step reproduces the three-component distribution check before testing
active thresholds. It does not select the active threshold.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(mixtools)
library(ggplot2)

# Wrapper around the mixture-model functions used in this workflow.
EM_fun <- function(x, pi, mu, sigsq, eps, verb = NULL, ncomp = 2) {
  if (ncomp == 2) {
    em_fit <- mixtools::normalmixEM2comp(
      x = c(x),
      lambda = pi,
      mu = mu,
      sigsqrd = sigsq,
      eps = eps,
      verb = verb
    )
  } else if (ncomp == 3) {
    em_fit <- mixtools::normalmixEM(
      x = c(x),
      lambda = pi,
      mu = mu,
      sigma = sqrt(sigsq),
      epsilon = eps,
      k = ncomp,
      verb = verb
    )
  } else {
    stop("ncomp must be either 2 or 3")
  }

  out_data <- list(
    posterior = em_fit$posterior,
    pi = em_fit$lambda,
    mu = em_fit$mu,
    sigsq = em_fit$sigma^2
  )

  return(out_data)
}
```

## 1. Input

```{r input}
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

  repeat {
    has_readme <- file.exists(file.path(current, "README.md"))
    has_notebooks <- dir.exists(file.path(current, "notebooks"))
    has_data <- dir.exists(file.path(current, "data"))

    if (has_readme && has_notebooks && has_data) {
      return(current)
    }

    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop("Open this file from within the repository containing README.md, notebooks/, and data/.")
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
sample_name <- "p28_330_HET_009"

probability_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "results", sample_name, "01_mgtoolbox_signal",
  paste0(sample_name, "_mg_probability_3d.rds")
)

mg_probability_3d <- readRDS(probability_file)

cat("Dimensions (X, Y, Z):", paste(dim(mg_probability_3d), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

## 2. Normalize and sample the 3D voxel values

```{r normalize-and-sample}
normalization_divisor <- max(mg_probability_3d, na.rm = TRUE)
normalized_values <- as.vector(mg_probability_3d) / normalization_divisor
normalized_values <- normalized_values[is.finite(normalized_values)]

set.seed(330009)
number_to_sample <- min(600000L, length(normalized_values))
density_sample <- sample(normalized_values, number_to_sample)

# Perturb exact zeros to prevent a zero-variance component.
zero_index <- density_sample == 0
density_sample[zero_index] <- runif(sum(zero_index), 0, 1e-10)

rm(mg_probability_3d, normalized_values)
gc()

cat("Normalization divisor:", normalization_divisor, "\n")
cat("Sampled voxels:", length(density_sample), "\n")
```

## 3. Fit the three-component model

```{r fit-three-components}
fit <- EM_fun(
  x = density_sample,
  pi = c(0.60, 0.32, 0.08),
  mu = c(0.008, 0.040, 0.192),
  sigsq = c(0.0128^2, 0.0192^2, 0.128^2),
  eps = 1e-6,
  verb = FALSE,
  ncomp = 3
)

component_order <- order(fit$mu)

component_table <- data.frame(
  component = c("Noise 1", "Noise 2", "Signal"),
  mixture_weight = fit$pi[component_order],
  mean = fit$mu[component_order],
  standard_deviation = sqrt(fit$sigsq[component_order])
)

component_table
```

## 4. Calculate the intersections between adjacent components

```{r intersections}
weighted_density <- function(value, component_index) {
  component_table$mixture_weight[component_index] * dnorm(
    value,
    mean = component_table$mean[component_index],
    sd = component_table$standard_deviation[component_index]
  )
}

find_last_intersection <- function(first_component, second_component) {
  difference <- function(value) {
    weighted_density(value, first_component) -
      weighted_density(value, second_component)
  }

  search_grid <- seq(
    component_table$mean[first_component],
    component_table$mean[second_component],
    length.out = 10001
  )

  difference_values <- vapply(search_grid, difference, numeric(1))
  crossing_index <- which(
    difference_values[-length(difference_values)] *
      difference_values[-1] <= 0
  )

  if (length(crossing_index) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  crossing_index <- crossing_index[length(crossing_index)]

  uniroot(
    difference,
    c(search_grid[crossing_index], search_grid[crossing_index + 1L])
  )$root
}

intersection_table <- data.frame(
  intersection = c("Noise 1 / Noise 2", "Noise 2 / Signal"),
  normalized_probability = c(
    find_last_intersection(1, 2),
    find_last_intersection(2, 3)
  )
)

intersection_table
```

## 5. Display the three fitted curves

```{r plot-three-curves}
probability_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 2000)

curve_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:3, function(component_index) {
  data.frame(
    normalized_probability = probability_grid,
    density = weighted_density(probability_grid, component_index),
    component = component_table$component[component_index]
  )
}))

distribution_plot <- ggplot(
  curve_data,
  aes(
    x = normalized_probability,
    y = density,
    color = component
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    data = intersection_table,
    aes(xintercept = normalized_probability),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Noise 1" = "#0072B2",
    "Noise 2" = "#56B4E9",
    "Signal" = "#009E73"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = paste("3D MGtoolbox probability distribution:", sample_name),
    x = "Normalized MGtoolbox probability",
    y = "Weighted density",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(distribution_plot)
```

Use the three fitted components and their intersections only to define a
reasonable interval of active-threshold candidates. The final active threshold
will be chosen later with the quantitative hitting-map metric.
